translation.question: Ni mtangazaji gani wa kike wa televisheni aliyekuwa mtangazaji mwenza wa usiku wa kwanza wa Tamasha la Muziki la Sanremo 2025?
translation.translation_note: Translated 'co-hosted' as 'aliyekuwa mtangazaji mwenza wa' (was co-presenter of) for natural phrasing in Swahili.

backtranslation_en.question: Which female television presenter was the co-host of the first night of the Sanremo Music Festival 2025?
